items.titolo: Microsoft elimina Copilot da Excel, ecco perché

items.titolo: Google Workspace lets Gemini access your company data by default - how to shut it down
items.descrizione: In Google Workspace, Gemini has access to Gmail, Docs, Calendar, Chat, and more by default. Here's why it matters, and how administrators can disable it today.
